title: Relay race
hints: Each step runs in its own goroutine but must not begin until the previous step has finished. Give each step a channel to wait on and a channel to close when it's done.

Chain them: step i waits on prev, runs, then closes its own done channel. That channel becomes prev for step i+1. Close the first prev yourself so step 0 can start, and wait on the last done before returning.
prev := make(chan struct{}); close(prev); for _, s := range steps { done := make(chan struct{}); go func(wait <-chan struct{}) { <-wait; s(); close(done) }(prev); prev = done }; <-prev
